hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=$(command -v spec-spine || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/spec-spine"); if [ -x "$sc" ]; then "$sc" compile >/dev/null 2>&1 && reg='recompiled fresh' || reg='compile FAILED, run spec-spine compile'; "$sc" index check >/dev/null 2>&1 && idx='fresh' || idx='STALE, run spec-spine index'; bd=$("$sc" index render 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'W-001' || echo '?'); else reg='spec-spine CLI absent, run /setup'; idx='spec-spine CLI absent, run /setup'; bd='?'; fi; echo "[session-freshness] spec registry: $reg; codebase index: $idx; burndown: $bd unresolved unit(s)"; true

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[hook] jq missing, staleness check skipped'; exit 0; }; fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=$(command -v spec-spine || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/spec-spine"); [ -x "$sc" ] || exit 0; case "$fp" in */specs/*/spec.md) "$sc" compile >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[spec-registry] recompiled after spec edit' || echo '[spec-registry] compile FAILED after spec edit, run spec-spine compile' ;; esac; case "$fp" in */specs/*/spec.md|*/spec-spine.toml|*/standards/*|*/.github/workflows/*|*/.claude/settings.json|*/.claude/agents/*|*/.claude/rules/*|*/.claude/skills/*|*/.mcp.json|*/AGENTS.md|*/CLAUDE.md|*/Makefile|*/apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json|*/apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/*|*/Cargo.toml|*/package.json|*/pnpm-workspace.yaml) "$sc" index check 2>&1 | tail -5 ;; esac; true

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in "gh pr create"*|*"&& gh pr create"*|*"; gh pr create"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=$(command -v spec-spine || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/spec-spine"); [ -x "$sc" ] || exit 0; "$sc" index >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$("$sc" couple --base origin/main --head HEAD 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then case "$cmd" in *--body*Spec-Drift-Waiver*) echo '[pr-gate] coupling gate failed; Spec-Drift-Waiver present after --body, allowing (CI honours the body-at-creation waiver).' ;; *) { echo '[pr-gate] BLOCKED: coupling gate failed and no Spec-Drift-Waiver in the PR body:'; echo "$out" | tail -25; echo '[pr-gate] Either fix the coupling (edit the owning spec.md so its relationship graph covers the changed paths, or claim the unowned file), or with explicit user approval include the Spec-Drift-Waiver block inline in --body (not --body-file) and retry.'; } >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi; if ! git diff --quiet -- .derived/ 2>/dev/null; then { echo '[pr-gate] BLOCKED: the index was regenerated and the result is uncommitted.'; echo '[pr-gate] Run: git add .derived/ then commit, push, and retry.'; } >&2; exit 2; fi; true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=$(command -v spec-spine || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/spec-spine"); [ -x "$sc" ] || exit 0; "$sc" index check >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; gd=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || gd=.git; if [ -d "$gd/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$gd/rebase-apply" ] || [ -f "$gd/MERGE_HEAD" ] || [ -f "$gd/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD" ]; then echo '[codebase-index] stale, but a rebase/merge is in progress, left untouched; run spec-spine index afterwards'; exit 0; fi; out=$("$sc" index 2>&1); if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo '[codebase-index] was stale, auto-regenerated via spec-spine index; review git diff .derived/ and include it in your commit'; else echo '[codebase-index] stale and spec-spine index FAILED:'; echo "$out" | tail -10; fi; true
